fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-08-15, the brother of the complainant, Mohan Gopal, aged 29, left for work and did not return; the last known location was near Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area. The time of the incident was given as 15:05 on 2025-08-12. The complaint was lodged by Nithya Murugan (9000000423), a family member of Mohan Gopal, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000456. Dinesh Subramani (9000000212) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complaint refers to Gunasekar Anand, a friend of the suspect, reachable on 9000000050. The family mentioned that Senthil Krishnan (9000000461) was last known to be in contact with the missing person. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Person reportedly left the residence and could not be contacted afterwards.
